about: Goods: what places make, trade and need (good, good_material, good_kind; a place's own rows are in stock/places/<place_id>.json `goods`). good_material names the materials of ours (materials.json) a maker of the good makes, good_kind the item kinds; a thing of them is local where the good is made (provenance). A ware's good is its item_good row (item_material.json `wares`).

goods.name: Bog-iron smithing
goods.about: Bog iron and copper-edged steel forged by one of the few smiths: blades, axes, maces, plate over masu skin and tools.

goods.name: Hide and leather
goods.about: Hides tanned into marsh leather (wamasu, crocodile, hackwing) and scale sewn on leather: light armour.

goods.name: Bone and horn work
goods.about: Bone and horn carved with bronze tools: daggers, short swords, maces, bows, flutes and charms.

goods.name: Flint and obsidian work
goods.about: Flint and jadeflint knapped and set in wood; in a few hands, volcanic glass.

goods.name: Chitin work
goods.about: Chitin shaped into light armour and shields, traded both ways over the Morrowind border.

goods.name: Shell work
goods.about: Turtle and haj mota shell for platters, mugs, shield bosses and whole shields.

goods.name: Reed weaving
goods.about: Reed, grass and fibre woven into mats, baskets, wraps and dolls.

goods.name: Feather dressing
goods.about: Wading-bird, hackwing and fellrunner feathers, dressed for fletching and finery.

goods.name: Sap and resin
goods.about: Tree sap and resin tapped for medicine, glue and alchemy (not the Hist's own), and the herbs gathered with it.

goods.name: Saltrice
goods.about: Saltrice grown in the paddies and estates, and the dishes made of it.

goods.name: Clay and pottery
goods.about: Red and mound clay worked into pots, jars and ochre-painted ware.

goods.name: Salt
goods.about: Salt from the coast pans, bartered inland.

goods.name: Tin chimes
goods.about: The Chime-Keepers' tin and bone chimes.

goods.name: Salvage
goods.about: What wrecks, ruins and drowned spires give up: metal, carved stone, foreign goods.

goods.name: Timber and stone
goods.about: Timber felled and stone quarried, and the heavy tools of both.

goods.name: Eggs
goods.about: Bird and reptile eggs gathered for food.

goods.name: River fish
goods.about: Fish netted and speared from the rivers.

goods.name: River goods
goods.about: Whatever the rafts and rootworms bring down the rivers to be redistributed: the interior's crafts and the coast's imports.
